einzeiler: A bombshell report exposes extreme force-feeding methods used on a detained hunger…
kurzfassung: Federal immigration officials have obtained judicial approval to perform a non-consensual surgical procedure on a detained hunger striker. Meanwhile, a federal appeals court ruled that Americans have no constitutional right to clean drinking water. In addition, the conflict with Iran escalated after U.S. forces disabled three oil tankers in the Persian Gulf.
stichpunkte: An ICE detainee in Texas faces a court-approved surgical force-feeding procedure via an abdominal feeding tube.
The detainee is reportedly the 19th hunger striker subjected to involuntary medical procedures since January 2025.
The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that the Constitution does not guarantee a right to clean drinking water or accurate official information.
The U.S. military disabled three Iranian oil tankers after ballistic missiles were fired at American naval ships.
Diesel prices hit a record $5.85 a gallon as the conflict with Iran impacts fuel costs.
Jared Kushner and Steve Woodcock traveled to Moscow to meet with Vladimir Putin regarding Ukraine war negotiations.
